evidence.note: Agent decomposes the port into 7 explicit tasks (TaskCreate) covering Cargo, schema, helpers, routes, middleware, job queue, build+verify — establishing a running subsystem checklist.

Uses TaskUpdate to flip tasks to in_progress/completed as it goes, but marks 'completed' right after writing the code (batch-completing several at once), so the ledger tracks implementation milestones, not verified parity.
Verification is limited to shallow smoke tests (health + a few endpoints); no differential harness produces per-subsystem pass/fail to back the coverage picture.
Brief investigation of a tag-handling mismatch, then marks the task completed — no regression check against previously-passing subsystems and no stuck-detection/reallocation.

reasoning: The agent keeps and updates a running checklist of subsystems (above the vague level-3 behavior), matching part of anchor 5, but the status flips are driven by 'code written' rather than harness-verified parity, and verification is only shallow smoke tests. There is no per-subsystem pass/fail from a differential harness, no regression guard when editing shared code, and no recognition of circular debugging — so it falls short of anchor 8. It sits between 3 and 5, landing at 4.
